'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Iran and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The [[United States Department of Commerce]] issues a $15 million bounty for information on [[Hossein Hatefi Ardakani]], an [[Iran]]ian businessman accused of procuring parts for drones assembled by Iran's [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] that were later sold to [[Russia]]. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/u-s-issues-15-million-bounty-targeting-alleged-iran-drone-middleman-6bde3bf9 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
*[[Moro conflict]]
**Nine Dawlah Islamiyah militants are killed while four [[Philippine Army|soldiers]] are injured during a [[shootout]] in the village of Taporug near [[Piagapo]] town in [[Lanao del Sur]], [[Philippines]]. Two of the killed were suspected of being involved in the [[Mindanao State University bombing|December 2023 Mindanao bombing]]; six other militants are on the run. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-dawlah-islamiyah-militants-marawi-mass-bombing-cc38a4b1a9e712c9f8636dabbae4bc27 (AP)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Four police officers are killed in an ambush on a [[highway]] near [[Celaya]], [[Guanajuato]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-police-killed-guanajuato-a077d3deac5b413c8f2dd6a70418a2ec (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*{{ill|2024 Greater São Paulo Piper PA-24 Comanche crash|pt|Acidente do Piper PA-24 prefixo PT-DKA em 2024}}
**A [[Piper PA-24 Comanche]] crashes in the forest region between [[Rio Grande da Serra]] and [[Ribeirão Pires]], in [[Greater São Paulo]], [[Brazil]]. Two people were killed. [https://oglobo.globo.com/brasil/sao-paulo/noticia/2024/01/25/duas-pessoas-morrem-em-queda-de-aviao-de-pequeno-porte-na-grande-sp.ghtml (O Globo)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in the United States]]
**[[Capital punishment in Alabama]]
***The state of [[Alabama]] executes convicted murderer [[Execution of Kenneth Eugene Smith|Kenneth Smith]] using [[Inert gas asphyxiation|nitrogen hypoxia]], the first time the technique is used. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/01/25/health/what-is-nitrogen-hypoxia.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Assassination of Vladlen Tatarsky]] 
**A court in [[Russia]] sentences {{ill|Darya Trepova|ru|Трепова, Дарья Евгеньевна}} to 27 years in prison for the assassination of [[Vladlen Tatarsky]] in April 2023. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-girkin-strelkov-putin-court-f1fbe68cdd2627fba16b2cff9ab89fa1 (AP)]
*[[Kyoto Animation arson attack]]
**A court in [[Japan]] sentences Shinji Aoba [[Capital punishment in Japan|to death]] for a 2019 [[arson]] attack on a [[Kyoto Animation]] studio in [[Fushimi-ku, Kyoto]], which killed 36 people. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/japan-kyoto-animation-fire-arson-attack-2019-arsonist-death-sentence-4073316 (CNA)]
*[[Taiwan]] officially begins extending its [[compulsory military service]] from four months to one year amid increased tensions with [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taiwan-begins-extended-one-year-conscription-response-china-threat-2024-01-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[South Korea]]n politician [[Bae Hyun-jin]] is attacked and hospitalized in [[Seoul]]. [https://koreajoongangdaily.joins.com/news/2024-01-25/national/politics/PPP-lawmaker-Bae-Hyunjin-hospitalized-after-attack-in-Seoul/1967175 (''Korea JoongAng Daily'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[NASA]] announces the retirement of Mars Helicopter ''[[Ingenuity (helicopter)|Ingenuity]]'' after the vehicle sustained damage to one of its rotors. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/01/25/science/nasa-ingenuity-helicopter-mars.html (''The New York Times'')]
